sources.citation: Menten et al. (2007), The distance to the Orion Nebula
ESO ESO · optical image and publisher astrometry; registration retained in the observation recipe

introduction.text: The Orion Nebula is a Milky Way H II region about 414 parsecs away. Its bright gas surrounds the young Orion Nebula Cluster.

distance.method: Adopted published trigonometric parallax; not a fitted image scale.

classification.name: H II region
classification.basis: Source-colored relative emission fitted to aligned ESO images. Its coherent depth surface is an evidence-guided hypothesis, not measured gas density. Compact-light positions and display photometry are image-derived; their depths are conditional, not measured stellar distances.
